items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: His lengthy list of collaborators includes three of the four Beatles, James Taylor, Paul Simon, and Steve Gadd.

ctx.x: David Spinozza has been a first-call guitarist for recordings and gigs since the early 1970s. His lengthy list of collaborators includes three of the four Beatles, James Taylor, Paul Simon, and Steve Gadd.
Dave was interviewed via Zoom on September 27, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
